🔥🇲🇽 THEY SOLD TEACHING JOBS AND KEPT THE PAYCHECKS

Ten State of Mexico officials are now in pretrial detention for a payroll scam running since 2021: 168 ghost teachers registered through 324 fake payroll movements, each handed a debit card paying 2,000–4,000 pesos a fortnight — then the ring kept the cards, skimming around 10 million pesos a month off the state education budget.

🇲🇽🏭 FOREIGN INVESTMENT HITS RECORD $23.6 BILLION IN MEXICO

Mexico drew a record 23,591 million dollars in foreign direct investment in Q1 2026 — up 10.4% year-on-year and the strongest first quarter ever, per El Financiero on Economy Ministry data. 94.2% ($22.2B) was profit reinvestment: companies already operating here doubling down. The US led with $10.2B, Spain $3.8B.

🚨🇲🇽 MEXICO'S FINANCIAL UNIT FREEZES A CJNG SHELL-COMPANY NETWORK

Mexico's Financial Intelligence Unit (UIF) froze the accounts of 11 people tied to a CJNG money-laundering network — including an accountant who set up shell companies in the cartel's name — after analyzing cases flagged by US authorities. The UIF called it coordinated action that "strengthens international cooperation mechanisms," acting on its own blocked-persons list, under Mexican law.

🚨🇲🇽 NATIONAL GUARD HELPED CUT HOMICIDES 46%, SAYS SHEINBAUM

On the National Guard's 7th anniversary, Sheinbaum said the institution helped drive a 46% drop in daily homicides — built on attacking root causes and intelligence, not mass incarceration. "The Guard is making history for the country's security," she said.

🇲🇽🩺 MEXICO PUTS 20 BILLION PESOS INTO PUBLIC HEALTH EQUIPMENT

The government is investing around 20 billion pesos to re-equip IMSS, ISSSTE and IMSS-Bienestar: 17 new MRI machines across 11 states (lifting weekly scans per unit from 80 to 150), 2,275 hospital beds, 5 linear accelerators, 117 AI-enabled mammography units — and Mexico's first public Fetal Surgery Unit, in Tabasco.

🇲🇽🌎 SHEINBAUM TO OPEN A NATIONAL DEBATE ON REGULATING BIG TECH AND AI

After the World Cup, Sheinbaum will launch a national discussion on regulating social media and artificial intelligence — not censorship, but confronting who owns the platforms and who controls the algorithms. "Who controls artificial intelligence? What beneficial uses does it have? What should concern us?" she asked, opening the table to specialists, legislators, media and parents. Digital sovereignty is now on the agenda.

🔥🇲🇽 MEXICO'S AUDITOR FILES 21 CRIMINAL CASES OVER 600M PESOS IN STOLEN PUBLIC MONEY

Mexico's Superior Audit Office (ASF) filed 21 criminal complaints with the FGR over more than 600 million pesos in damage to the treasury, hitting around 30 officials across all three levels of government in the first review of Sheinbaum's opening year. It's the first fruit of an April 21 oversight reform that lets the ASF investigate and denounce without waiting for the full audit cycle to close.

🇲🇽⚽ "Pick up your trash — it's the cleaning workers who have to collect it all." "Pick up your trash when you leave, because it's the cleaning workers who afterward have to do all this collecting." — President Claudia Sheinbaum Ahead of Mexico vs. Ecuador, the president wished the national team strength — "mucha fuerza" — and asked fans to celebrate with respect and clean up after themselves.
